label: Machine
value: Intel Core i5-12600K, 16 threads, 64 GB, Windows 11

label: JVM
value: OpenJDK 25.0.1, 12 GB heap, G1, one JVM per scenario

label: Scenarios
value: A reference shape; four sweeps that each change one thing of it (applications, instances, message types, budget); the standalone deployment profile, and the embedded one until run 3

label: Coverage
value: Runs 1 to 3: every scenario; runs 4 to 6: every scenario but the embedded profile, removed with embedded mode. Runs 2 and 3 shared the machine with other work part of the time; runs 4 to 6 had it idle

label: Before measuring
value: The whole history, filled at 5,000 spans/s as fast as the hub takes it (the embedded profile at 2,000, until run 3), so scenarios that compare start from the same state

label: Each rate
value: Each rate of one ladder up to 300,000 spans/s offered for 30 s, open loop, until two fail in a row; the first 5 s of each are left out

label: Load
value: 4 generator threads; 8 submitting threads call admission and the intake queues

label: Exports
value: Every 5 s per instance, or as soon as it holds a full batch of 512 spans

label: Traces
value: Commands, queries, events across applications; 2% failed handlings; event-store delays 20 ms to 8 s

label: Not measured
value: OTLP/HTTP decoding and the network; queries; WebSocket sends to browsers
